note: Shared declarative test inputs, not a new wire format or an executable test runner. Only payload objects are MEMBERS JSON. Import identical fixtures and scenario assertions into Rust and Kotlin suites. Revision 2: causal readmits register, authored-only questions, inherited follow, local barrier origin and neutral silent-peer status. New local actions are declarative acceptance arrangements, not existing runner APIs.

conventions.each_scenario: Reset to initial_state; steps are sequential. Extra local actions arrange state under the normal lifecycle rules. Assertions name deltas or postconditions, not wire fields.
conventions.removal_tuple: Compare (hlc, writer_device) unsigned lexicographically. An equal tuple with a different status is malformed, not eligible stale gossip.
conventions.retire-and-rejoin: Arrange authorized own withdrawal, then fresh mutually enabled token join through A, preserving C barrier decisions; S may be joined again but setup generation changes.
conventions.prompt_count: One durable pending question per authored barrier and setup generation; dismiss/restart may redisplay that same coalesced question. Inherited barriers never ask.
conventions.replay_noop: No binding generation/reset/notice/provenance changes; normal receipt or clock bookkeeping may advance on a non-retained replay.
conventions.barrier_origin: remove-C-from-all-devices is a real committed local user action with an explicit deterministic stamp (same pin unless stamp=RP after replacement). It records authored=true; receive remove does not. Never derive origin from writer_device. Origin survives a newer removal while denied, resets on clear; missing old origin means authored.
conventions.local_clock: For a trial containing local Remove@R, run its preceding join/setup with an injected clock below R.hlc and last_seen strictly below R.hlc; Remove uses R.hlc and allocates exactly R, then restores clock_ms. reset-to-initial-state resets clock authority too. Never rewind an observed clock. All fixture HLCs are within the future bound under these clocks; later fresh pairs use restored clock_ms.
conventions.holder_trials: For actions that deliver an exported snapshot to independent holders, each named holder starts with S, authenticated enabled trust for the exporter and the specified exact-key R origin; keep the payload unchanged. These are separate receiver trials, not a wire attestation.
conventions.claim: Assertions readmits/retained_claim are the exact-key register, or null if absent. Superseded removal metadata is retained as high-water. Removing a key drops its claim, including before later stale claims arrive.
conventions.invalid_readmits_entries: Embed each raw_entry in an otherwise valid snapshot with the authenticated sender self member and a fresh transfer ID. Also test as the matching authenticated sender row where flagged: ignored claims still require full validation.
